name: Ewa Beach
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Ewa Beach, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Ewa Beach, Hawaii for 2026: a Lions Club parade, Santa story time, a Kroc Center market and Wai Kai night market.
lede: Ewa Beach celebrates Christmas with a community parade, Santa at the library and the Kroc Center, and a Christmas Night Market at Wai Kai.
celebrates: Ewa Beach's Christmas season centers on the Ewa Beach Lions Club Christmas Parade, listed on the Hawaii Lions District 50 calendar for Saturday, December 12, 2026. The Salvation Army Kroc Center Hawaii hosts a free Christmas Market with snowfall in its Courtyard, crafts and a photo with Santa on December 4. Ewa Beach Public and School Library offers Santa Claus Story Time on December 7, and Wai Kai adds a Christmas Edition of its Thursday Night Market with Santa on December 17. The Hawaiian Railway Society also runs its Holiday Express out of Ewa Beach, though it is sold out for 2026.
lastyear: The Ewa Beach Lions Club shared a video of its 2025 community Christmas parade, according to the Hawaii Lions page on Facebook. Hawaii News Now reported that the 2025 parade started in the Campbell High School parking lot, ran along North Road and Fort Weaver Road and returned to Campbell High School, with lanes closed from 8 to 11:30 am. The 2026 listing on the Lions District 50 calendar gives a 10 am to 1 pm time but does not print a route.
facts: The Hawaiian Railway Society calls its line 6.5 miles of restored track from Ewa Beach to Kahe Point, a registered national and state historic site. The Kroc Center Hawaii is a Salvation Army community center with an aquatic center, fitness center and gymnasium. Wai Kai is built around a 52-acre lagoon with unlimited vessel access, according to its site.
trains: Ewa Beach is home to the Hawaiian Railway Society, Oahu's only operating historic railway. Its standard ride is a two-hour narrated round trip from Ewa Beach to Kahe Point for $20, with pick-up in Ewa Beach or Ko Olina and a snack stop in Ko Olina on most rides. The society's Toy Train Museum has free admission. The society's website lists its 2026 Holiday Express as sold out, so check for cancellations or regular rides.

faq: How does Ewa Beach celebrate Christmas?

The Ewa Beach Lions Club holds a community Christmas parade each December. The Kroc Center, the library and Wai Kai add Santa visits, crafts and markets, and the Hawaiian Railway Society runs a Holiday Express train out of Ewa Beach in a normal year.
When is the Ewa Beach Christmas parade?

The Hawaii Lions District 50 calendar lists the Ewa Beach Christmas Parade for Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 am to 1 pm. The calendar names Lion Kurt at (808) 864-4634 as the contact. The route is not printed there, so confirm it with the club.
Can kids meet Santa in Ewa Beach?

Yes. Santa is at the Kroc Center Christmas Market on December 4, at Santa Claus Story Time at Ewa Beach Public and School Library on December 7, and at the Wai Kai Christmas Night Market on December 17.
Is there a Christmas train in Ewa Beach?

The Hawaiian Railway Society runs a Holiday Express, but its website lists the 2026 rides as sold out. Regular two-hour narrated rides to Kahe Point cost $20 and run on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays.
